notice: Nepal Gazette vol. 75 no. 67, part 5 (Falgun 18, 2082): the Ministry of Home Affairs' notice of the public, festival and substitute holidays of VS 2083

holidays.ne: चण्डी पूर्णिमा (वैशाख पूर्णिमा) - बुद्ध जयन्ती, राई, लिम्बू, याक्खा, सुनुवारलगायतका किराँत समुदायको उभौली पर्व
holidays.en: Chandi Purnima (the full moon of Baisakh): Buddha Jayanti, and Ubhauli of the Kirat community, the Rai, Limbu, Yakkha, Sunuwar and others
The Dashain holiday (from Phulpati to the 12th)
The Tihar holiday (from Lakshmi Puja to the day after Bhai Tika)

holidays.ne: धान्य पूर्णिमा - किराँत समुदायको उधौली पर्व, योमरी पुन्हि, ज्यापू दिवस
holidays.en: Dhanya Purnima: Udhauli of the Kirat community, Yomari Punhi and Jyapu Day
Christmas Day, the festival of the Christians (25 December)

holidays.ne: इस्लाम धर्मावलम्बीको पर्व ईद (ईद उल फित्र) का दिन
holidays.en: On the day of Eid (Eid al-Fitr), the festival of the Muslims

holidays.ne: इस्लाम धर्मावलम्बीको पर्व बकर ईद (ईद उल अजहा) का दिन
holidays.en: On the day of Bakr Eid (Eid al-Adha), the festival of the Muslims
Fagu Purnima, in the 56 mountain and hill districts

holidays.ne: फागुपूर्णिमा - तराईका जिल्ला झापा, मोरङ, सुनसरी, सप्तरी, सिराहा, उदयपुर, धनुषा, महोत्तरी, सर्लाही, रौतहट, बारा, पर्सा, नवलपरासी (बर्दघाट सुस्ता पूर्व), नवलपरासी (बर्दघाट सुस्ता पश्चिम), रुपन्देही, कपिलवस्तु, दाङ, बाँके, बर्दिया, कैलाली र कञ्चनपुरमा
holidays.en: Fagu Purnima, in the Terai districts: Jhapa, Morang, Sunsari, Saptari, Siraha, Udayapur, Dhanusha, Mahottari, Sarlahi, Rautahat, Bara, Parsa, Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta East), Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta West), Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Dang, Banke, Bardiya, Kailali and Kanchanpur
Gai Jatra (for the Newar community across the country only)

holidays.ne: दुरा म्हैप्रु नकुमा (देशभरका दुरा समुदायका लागि मात्र)
holidays.en: Dura Mhaipru Nakuma (for the Dura community across the country only)

holidays.ne: सिरुवा पावनीको दिन - सो पर्व मनाउने झापा, मोरङ, सुनसरी, सिराहा र सप्तरी जिल्लामा
holidays.en: On the day of Sirua Pavani, in the districts that keep it: Jhapa, Morang, Sunsari, Siraha and Saptari

holidays.ne: जितिया पर्व (जितिया पर्व मनाउने महिला कर्मचारीको लागि)
holidays.en: Jitiya (for the women employees who keep it)
Gai Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley
Indra Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley

holidays.ne: मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको भोटो देखाउने जात्रा (सो जात्रा हुने दिन)
holidays.en: The jatra showing Matsyendranath's vest (on the day of the jatra), in the Kathmandu valley
Ghode Jatra, in the Kathmandu valley

holidays.ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अपाङ्गता दिवस (डिसेम्बर ३) (अपाङ्गता भएका नेपालभित्रका सम्पूर्ण कर्मचारीको लागि)
holidays.en: International Day of Persons with Disabilities (3 December), for every employee in Nepal with a disability
Falgunanda Jayanti (for the followers of the Kirat religion)
On the day of Mohammad Jayanti (for Nepali Muslims)

holidays.ne: गुरु नानक जयन्तीका दिन (नेपाली सिख धर्मावलम्बी)
holidays.en: On the day of Guru Nanak Jayanti (for Nepali Sikhs)

holidays.ne: जातीय भेदभाव तथा छुवाछुत उन्मूलन राष्ट्रिय दिवस
holidays.en: National Day for the Elimination of Caste Discrimination and Untouchability
